sideA.text:
THIS PACKAGE INCLUDES:
• 15 cards • 1 sticker card

RECON REPORT

We have accessed Utopia.
But, this is no utopia... This is hell
on Earth. Utopia's mission? Kill the
Faded and the people we are helping
and then repopulate the world with
uninfected humans. Every year they
expel males to keep their population
down and their people in check. These
Hollow Men are tasked to destroy us
in order to be allowed home. What's
more, Utopia has had the PEARL
laboratory under armed guard for 30
years. Utopia has been holding the
cure from the world.

They were just waiting for us to die.

Read both sides of this card
then keep it in the reserve.

sideB.text:
RIGHT NOW!

Open the following door if you have not
done so already:
61

You have connected a new city: Utopia.
• Add the Player card for Utopia
to the Player discard pile.
• Add all 8 Infection cards for Utopia
to the Infection discard pile.
• Add the "Riot Control" Unrationed Event
to the Player discard pile.
• Put the 4 Hollow Men Gather cards
into the Infection discard pile.

rules: On opening the package, open door 61 if it is not already open.
Utopia joins the grid. Its one Player card goes to the Player discard pile.
All 8 Utopia Infection cards go to the Infection discard pile, not the Game End area.
Riot Control goes to the Player discard pile, not to a player's hand.
The 4 Hollow Men Gather cards go into the Infection discard pile.
Keep this report in the reserve after both sides have been read.
notes: The package lists 15 cards and 1 sticker card. The 15 are this report, Riot Control, 1 Utopia Player card, 8 Utopia Infection cards, and 4 Hollow Men Gather cards.
Nothing in this package goes to the reserve except this report.
